notes: Dashboard Navigator counts now auto-refresh every 15 seconds so pending youth check-in verification and current check-in tiles update after new check-ins.
Youth check-ins auto-approve into an existing active profile when the submitted profile information matches, ignoring purpose of visit for matching.
FYI was added as a program; FYI/PSH youth are flagged as event-only, can remain active at 25+, and are blocked from service usage while still allowing event participation.
Chart notes can notify multiple staff and pinned chart notes now appear in the Youth Log selected-youth panel.
Reports now break current stay into Homeless, Short Term, Shelter, Supported Housing, and Non-Supported Housing, with category timing metrics and charts that preserve all-time first-contact history.
